subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should this Discord `media://inbound` resolver report stay open until a live Discord DM reproduction identifies the missing ID/root/lifetime path?
rationale: Current source proves the relevant resolver and Discord media handoff path, but generic tests pass and related PRs cover different failure modes, so automation cannot safely choose a repair without better proof.

options.title: Require Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted live logs or a recording showing the saved file, emitted media URI, active state dir, and image-tool failure on current main.

options.title: Fold Into A Broader Media Retention Investigation
options.body: Treat this as part of the related repeated-read/retention cluster if maintainers want one cross-channel owner to investigate disappearing media IDs.

options.title: Queue A Source-Only Fix Now
options.body: Start a fix PR from source inspection alone, accepting a higher chance of changing the wrong media boundary.

recommendation.title: Require Live Discord Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted live logs or a recording showing the saved file, emitted media URI, active state dir, and image-tool failure on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current feature-history signal for managed inbound media references is the merged media-reference work in PR 87101.
